title: Confidence in a domain comes from the depth of context around it

sections.name: words
sections.content:
So we don't necessarily need to base confidence on a purely numeric thing.

If we look at the bigger issue in SRS programme of problems and domains.

We should be able to assess the confidence we have in a domain by the depth of the context we have around it. If we have many vignettes that discuss the same issues, a set of problems that keep emerging, we should be able to assess a higher confidence level
